title: Office Supplies & Equipment
completion_message: ¡Buen trabajo! Ya dominas el vocabulario de suministros y equipos de oficina.

parts.visual: Equipos (Equipment): Printer (Impresora). Photocopier (Fotocopiadora). Shredder (Trituradora de papel). Scanner (Escáner). Projector (Proyector).
parts.audio: Office equipment. Printer. Photocopier. Shredder. Scanner. Projector.

parts.visual: Suministros (Supplies): Stapler (Engrapadora). Paperclip (Clip). Folder (Carpeta). Notepad (Bloc de notas). Ink cartridge (Cartucho de tinta). 'We are out of ink' (Nos quedamos sin tinta).
parts.audio: Office supplies. Stapler. Paperclip. Folder. Notepad. Ink cartridge. We are out of ink.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra correcta para referirte a los objetos de la oficina.

questions.question: I need to print this document. Is the ____ working? (Impresora).
The ____ is out of paper. We can't make copies. (Fotocopiadora).
Destroy these confidential documents in the ____. (Trituradora de papel).
questions.explanation: Shredder = trituradora de papel (de 'shred' = hacer tiras).

questions.question: Could you ____ these pages together, please? (Engrapar).
Where is the ____? I need to put these pages together. (Engrapadora).
Use a ____ to keep those two papers together temporarily. (Clip).
Put all the project documents in this blue ____. (Carpeta).
I like to write my ideas on a ____. (Bloc de notas).
The printer is out of ____. The pages are blank. (Tinta).
questions.explanation: Out of ink = sin tinta / se acabó la tinta.

questions.question: We need to order a new ink ____. (Cartucho).
Mail this letter. You need an ____. (Sobre).
I need to stick this paper to the wall. Do you have any ____? (Cinta adhesiva).
Use ____ if you want to paste the photos in the notebook. (Pegamento).
Turn on the ____. We want to see the presentation on the big screen. (Proyector).
You can leave a note on the ____ board in the kitchen. (Tablero de anuncios).
I made a mistake in my drawing. Do you have an ____? (Borrador/Goma).
Use a ____ to mark the important parts of the text. (Resaltador).
The ____ ran out of staples. (Engrapadora).
We need to order more office ____. (Suministros/Material de oficina).
questions.explanation: Office supplies = suministros / material de oficina.

questions.question: A printer is a piece of office ____. (Equipo).
questions.explanation: Office equipment = equipo de oficina (impresoras, computadoras).

stages.title: Written Expression
